title: Liquid AI Launches 24B Model as Largest Release to Date
summary:
The new reasoning tool utilizes a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture to enable fast, private agentic intelligence on laptops and PCs. The LFM2.5-24B-A2B model consists of 24B total parameters with 2B active per token, a 131K token context window, and a 128K token vocabulary. Trained on 33T tokens, the model has open base and post-trained weights on Hugging Face and outperforms the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on agentic tasks, scoring 48.09 vs 38.19 on LiveClaw and 27.69 vs 8.72 on AutomationBench.

SGLang provides day-0 support for the model, which reaches output speeds of 21K tokens per second on a single NVIDIA B300 and 184 tokens per second on an Apple M5 Max. Liquid AI developed the model for multi-step agenting tasks within popular harnesses, prioritizing local execution to reduce computational costs and improve privacy.
